raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
When --max-running-requests is small (e.g. single-request latency tiers) and --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode is unset, the GPU-capacity default (up to 512) dwarfs the running batch. The server then captures - and reserves memory for - batch sizes it can never replay.

This clamps the default to the running limit. An explicit --cuda-graph-max-bs-decode keeps its existing semantics, and the materialized capture list follows via the existing max_bs filter.

## Test plan
- New CPU unit test test/registered/unit/server_args/test_decode_graph_max_bs_default.py (3 cases: clamp to 1 with bs == [1]; default kept at 512 with no running limit; explicit 64 preserved) - passes; the clamp case fails without the fix.
- Existing test/registered/unit/server_args/test_server_args.py - passes except one pre-existing upstream failure (TestDcpCommBackendDefault::test_a5_npu_supports_dcp), which also fails on clean origin/main and never invokes the touched code path.
- GPU/runtime coverage deferred to CI.
